## Description

Tilt toward smaller market-cap stocks, sometimes combined with value and quality filters.

## Where it may fit

Long horizons where size exposure is compensated; diversified universes with adequate liquidity management.

## Vehicles

Small-cap mutual funds/ETFs, factor portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time market capitalization, returns, share class history, liquidity, spreads and delisting returns.

## Caveats

Capacity constraints, trading costs and long stretches without a size premium are common.
